subject: CAIQ: tenant scope & runtime evidence bundle — Greenline
messages:
From: Alex Soto <infra-security@greenlinebank.com>
To: elliot.price@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: CAIQ intake — tenant scope clarification and evidence request

Elliot / Marissa —

Thanks for taking this on. We started the CAIQ review and need a tighter mapping for the tenant boundary and a small set of runtime evidence samples so our auditors can validate isolation controls and key rotation practices. Specifically we need:

- A short mapping that identifies which CAIQ controls map to your multi-tenant design (hint: sections around tenant isolation, data partitioning, and keystore access).
- Representative runtime logs covering a 24-hour window (UTC) showing tenant request traces and key access events.
- A statement of any compensating controls (if a control is partially met).

Can you provide the mapping and evidence bundle by EOD Monday (Nov 22)? If not, propose a walkthrough time next week and we'll adjust.

Attachments: none yet — please provide attachments as links or zipped stubs.

Alex Soto
Senior Infrastructure Security Engineer
Greenline Bank

From: elliot.price@redwood.com <elliot.price@redwood.com>
To: Alex Soto <infra-security@greenlinebank.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake — tenant scope clarification and evidence request

Alex —

Appreciate the clear ask. We're on it and can deliver the initial package and a short mapping doc. Quick plan: 

1) I'll attach the CAIQ-to-control crosswalk (spreadsheet) that shows which Redwood controls map to Greenline's scoped items.
2) Marissa will assemble a 24-hour runtime log sample (anonymized) and a short narrative on keystore access patterns.
3) Jonas will provide a note on compensating controls for a couple of items we treat via network segmentation rather than stricter tenant-level enforcement.

Deliverables (target):
- caiq_mapping_greenline_v1.xlsx (attached)
- runtime_log_sample_20261101-1107.zip (attached; contains sanitized traces and access events)
- tenant_isolation_rationale.md (link in the Drive binder)

If you prefer a walkthrough, we can do 30 minutes Tuesday (Nov 23) 10:00–10:30 PT. Otherwise we'll deliver the binder by COB Monday and you can follow up with questions.

Thanks,

Elliot Price
Growth Security Lead | Redwood Inference
elliot.price@redwood.com | (415) 555-0183

Attachments:
- caiq_mapping_greenline_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
- runtime_log_sample_20261101-1107.zip (application/zip)

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Soto <infra-security@greenlinebank.com>, elliot.price@redwood.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake — tenant scope clarification and evidence request

Alex — quick follow-up from our side with details on the artifacts you asked for:

- Runtime logs: sanitized traces are in the attached zip. File list inside: runtime_requests_20261101.ndjson, keystore_access_20261101.log. We removed all PII and replaced tenant IDs with pseudonyms.
- Keystore explanation: see tenant_isolation_rationale.md in the Drive binder (link below). It explains our HSM integration, KMS rotation schedule, and access control lists.
- Compensating controls: Jonas wrote an overview; we documented segmentation rules and the egress filtering policy that reduces lateral risk.

Drive binder: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/greenline-caiq-binder
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/GLB-4721
DocuSign envelope (for the data processing addendum if needed): https://www.docusign.com/fake-envelope/0a1b2c3d

If you need full, unredacted logs for a direct audit, we'll need a data processing agreement signed — happy to iterate on that in parallel.

-Marissa Cole
Security Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Received, and thanks for the quick turnaround. I downloaded the mapping spreadsheet and skimmed the log bundle — looks like the pseudonyms are in place and the keystore events are present. Couple of quick asks before we close the ticket: 

- Could we schedule the 30-minute walkthrough on Tuesday (Nov 23) at 10:00 PT — please send a calendar invite.
- For the compensating controls note, can Jonas add a short diagram (PNG) of the segmentation zones? That helps our auditor.
- We'll likely request one unredacted 4-hour window for an in-person review under NDA; please flag who on your side owns that process so we can coordinate the DPA/docsign flow.

If you confirm the walkthrough and who owns the unredacted access process, we'll mark the CAIQ item as satisfied pending the short follow-up demo.

Best,
Alex Soto
infra-security@greenlinebank.com
